steps.title: People ask in ChatGPT
steps.text: Contoso employees work in ChatGPT Enterprise and use skills for activity capture, investor intent and data quality.

steps.title: Planned: ChatGPT reads the data lake
steps.text: A Contoso-built MCP server gives ChatGPT access to data in the Azure data lake.

steps.title: ChatGPT calls Salesforce
steps.text: The standard hosted MCP servers expose Salesforce records. Each person signs in with their own Salesforce login.

steps.title: Salesforce enforces access
steps.text: Every read or write runs as that user, so field security, object permissions and sharing rules still apply.

steps.title: Coworker inside Salesforce
steps.text: People who live in Salesforce get the same help from Agentforce Coworker without leaving the app.

steps.title: Next: Headless 360 MCP
steps.text: Move from the set of standard servers to the Headless 360 MCP server once it is generally available.

steps.title: Planned: Contoso React app
steps.text: A custom React app on Salesforce for experiences that need their own screens.

cards.title: In place today
cards.text: ChatGPT Enterprise connected to Salesforce through the standard MCP servers, skills built at the on-site, and Coworker enabled for Salesforce users.

cards.title: Next
cards.text: Headless 360 MCP server, the Azure data lake MCP server and the Contoso React app.

cards.title: Worth deciding early
cards.text: Which skills may write to Salesforce, and how those changes are tracked. Start read-only with sobject-reads and widen access skill by skill.
